Add shrimp paste (terasi), salt, and coconut oil (do not heat the coconut oil), crush/mix by hand (use gloves so it doesn't burn from the chilies), add lime juice, stir evenly.
Serve the coriander fried chicken with sambal matah, warm rice, fresh cucumber and lettuce.

strMeal: Sambal Matah Resep Dari Chef Krisna Dari Bali
strInstructions:
Prepare the ingredients to make shrimp paste chili sauce (sambal terasi) a la Chef Krisna.
Cut the curly chilies and bird's eye chilies first, after that peel and cut the shallots, roast the shrimp paste (terasi) until slightly charred.
Cut the lime into 2 halves, but it's up to you how many pieces you want to cut the lime into, prepare cooking oil but the oil shouldn't be hot, prepare a small container or small bowl, add the chilies, then add the roasted shrimp paste and crush/mix it with the chilies, add the salt into the bowl.
Stir until evenly mixed, squeeze the lime into the bowl from earlier, after that stir again, add the oil into the bowl, stir again.
Add the shallots into the bowl, stir until evenly mixed, and the sambal matah recipe from Chef Krisna is done.

Cut the chicken into 4 or 8 pieces.
Prepare 2 containers for the seasoning flour. One container for the wet batter & one for the dry flour coating.
Container 1: pour about 70 grams of seasoning flour and mix with water little by little until it feels slightly thick. Add a little salt if you feel it's not salty enough (optional).
Container 2: pour 100 grams of seasoning flour for coating (add a little salt if you feel it's not salty enough (optional).
Dip the chicken into the wet batter, lift, and coat evenly with the dry flour.
Heat oil in a wok.
Fry the flour-coated crispy chicken until golden brown. Remove and drain.
Thinly chop the bird's eye chilies, shallots, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok.
Sauté the sliced bird's eye chilies, shallots, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves in the wok. Stir until everything is mixed.
Add a pinch of salt and 1/4 of a lime's juice. Sauté again until fragrant. Sambal matah is ready.
Next, crush (geprek) the crispy chicken with a wooden mortar and spread the sambal matah evenly on top of it.
Finally, plate the ayam geprek with warm white rice. Ayam geprek rice is ready to be served 😊.

Mash the tofu in a container (not too smooth).
Add seasonings (salt, Ladaku pepper, pepper powder, Masako), egg, and wheat flour, then stir evenly.
Heat oil, fry the tofu until cooked, and set aside. Next, make the sambal matah.
Finely slice all sambal matah ingredients, except lime and shrimp paste (terasi). You only need 1/4 of the lime for fragrance.
After slicing everything, put it in a frying pan with hot oil.
Sauté until the aroma comes out, then put the cooked tofu into the pan, and sauté again until mixed.

strMeal: Nasi Daun Jeruk Dengan Udang Dan Sambal Matah
strInstructions:
To make kaffir lime leaf rice: Chop the garlic, remove the center vein of the kaffir lime leaves, thinly slice the kaffir lime leaves. Sauté the garlic with margarine until fragrant, add the kaffir lime leaves, sauté until the garlic is browned. Pour it into the warm rice, add a little salt, stir evenly.
To make fried shrimp: Peel and wash the shrimp. Season with all-purpose flour. Fry until cooked.
To make sambal matah: Thinly slice the shallots, chilies, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves. Mix with salt and MSG. Pour hot oil and stir. Once even, add lime juice, stir again.

Cut the chicken wings in 2, wash clean, marinate with instant flour, egg, and cornstarch, the flour batter should not be too runny.
Cut the chili paste ingredients into small rounds (chilies, shallots, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass).
Prepare hot oil to fry the chicken wings, fry over low heat, make sure they are cooked all the way through.
Once cooked, drain, repeat frying until finished.
Pour hot oil over the finished sliced sambal matah, don't forget the seasonings (MSG, salt, sugar, shrimp paste/terasi), stir.
Arrange the chicken on a plate then pour the sambal matah over it. Sambal matah chicken wings are ready to be enjoyed. Eating it while hot is delicious.

Prepare the tuna. Wash clean, coat with lime juice. Cut the tuna and scallions into pieces. Then skewer with satay sticks, alternating tuna and scallions. Do this until finished.
Prepare the basting ingredients. Heat a pan. Grill the tuna, flipping it back and forth while basting with the basting ingredients. Do this until the tuna satay is cooked.
Prepare the sambal matah ingredients, thinly slice everything. Mix evenly, add lime juice. Let sit for a moment.
Heat oil, pour the hot oil into the chili paste container. Make sure the chili paste container is heat-resistant.
Serve the tuna satay with sambal matah. Awesome 👌.
strIngredient4: Large scallions, take the white part

strInstructions:
Slice the ginger lengthwise, sprinkle the fish with enough salt. Prepare a steamer, line with banana leaves. Arrange the fish on top, then evenly tuck the ginger in. Steam for about 15 minutes.
Shred the fish with a fork, separate the bones. Prepare a Teflon pan, pour 1 tsp palm oil, pan-fry the fish until browned.
Slice the shallots, lemongrass, chilies, and kaffir lime leaves (remove the stalks). Add sugar, salt, mushroom bouillon. Squeeze/massage until wilted.
Heat the Teflon pan, pour in coconut oil. Add shrimp paste (terasi). Crush until broken down, heat until the shrimp paste foams. Then pour over the sliced ingredients. Squeeze the juice of 1 lime over the chili paste.
Mix the sambal matah with the shredded mackerel (kembung) until even.
strIngredient5: Double kaffir lime leaves (daun jeruk kembar)

strMeal: Ayam Tapioka Sambal Matah#Kreasi Kami Tepung Tapioka Cap Pak Tani Gunung
strInstructions:
Prepare the cut chicken breast fillet, mix with the marinade ingredients.
Let sit for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, mix with 1 egg then coat in Cap Pak Tani Gunung tapioca flour, then fry over medium heat until cooked.
Serve warm with sambal matah.
strIngredient11: Tbsp Cap Pak Tani Gunung tapioca flour

strInstructions:
Cut the beef into small pieces so it's not tough. Marinate using the finely ground marinade spices. Cover tightly, then store in the refrigerator for 2-4 hours (the longer, the more tender).
Thinly slice for sambal matah: lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, coarsely chopped garlic & shallots.
Heat cooking oil, sauté chopped shallots and garlic (1-2 cloves), marinated beef for about 1 minute, add 1 small bowl of water, add pepper + flavor enhancer.
Wait until the water is gone. Make sure the meat is not tough.
Sambal matah: Heat oil, add sliced lemongrass + garlic until slightly wilted. Pour the hot oil + lemongrass + garlic over the sliced sambal matah mixture.
Mix the sambal matah with the cooked beef.
Finally, add a squeeze of lime juice. Stir well. Done.
strIngredient12: Portion of beef cut into small pieces

strInstructions:
Grind the shallots and chilies using a chopper, leave it somewhat coarse.
Heat a good amount of oil in a Teflon pan, low heat. Fry the crushed garlic until brown, remove.
Put the chopped ingredients into the hot oil, stir evenly.
Add MSG (micin), salt, sugar, and water. Stir evenly.
Cook while stirring frequently until the color changes and the oil appears to separate from the chili paste. Cool before transferring to a container.

✅Cut the intestines, then boil until the intestines are tender, remove and drain.
✅Sauté the shallots until fragrant, add the ground chilies, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until the spices are fully cooked.
✅Add the intestines, season, then add water.
✅Cook until the water reduces and the spices are absorbed. Check the taste.
✅Serve.

Shred the oyster mushrooms, wash clean, then squeeze out the water.
Fry the mushrooms in hot oil until cooked, remove and drain.
Slice the chilies, shallots, and garlic, sauté briefly.
Coarsely pound with salt, sugar, and mushroom bouillon. Pour hot oil over it, check the taste. Put the mushrooms in, press (penyet) them on top of the chili paste. Ready to be enjoyed.

strMeal: Sambal Bawang Cumi Asin Dan Keong
strInstructions:
Put the two types of chilies, shallots, garlic, and shrimp paste (terasi) into a chopper, then process until smooth, set aside.
Heat oil, then sauté the chopped spices until fragrant, then add the sliced kaffir lime leaves, stir evenly.
Then add the snails and salted squid, stir evenly.
Add water, salt, and flavor enhancer, then stir evenly.
Then cook until the spices are absorbed, check the taste, once it's right turn off the heat, then remove, place on a serving plate, and serve, enjoy...
strIngredient7: Small packet of roasted shrimp paste (terasi)

strInstructions:
Coarsely chop the garlic and set aside, coarsely chop the chilies, shallots, and kaffir lime leaves.
Put cooking oil into a wok then sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the red chilies, shallots, and kaffir lime leaves, stir evenly, once boiling add salt, granulated sugar, and mushroom bouillon, cook until done.
Test the taste and adjust to your liking, after it cools to room temperature, pour it into jars (if for sale, it can be weighed).

strMeal: Tahu   Bandeng Penyet Sambal Bawang Jeruk
strInstructions:
Cut the tofu, soak in saltwater and 1 grated garlic clove, then fry until browned.
Soak the milkfish (bandeng) with salt and lime juice for about 10 minutes, then drain, absorb excess water with kitchen paper towels, coat in glutinous rice flour, fry until cooked/dry but not too dry.
Pound the chilies, garlic, salt, and add lime juice.
Press (penyet) the tofu on top of the chili paste, add the fried milkfish and basil leaves.

✅Sauté the shallots until browned, add the pounded chilies, sauté until the spices are cooked.
✅Add the tuna, eggplant, and water.
✅Season with granulated sugar, salt, and bouillon powder. Cook until the water reduces. Check the taste.
✅Serve.

Mix the egg ingredients to make an omelet. Then cut it into pieces after it becomes an omelet.
Chop the chilies and garlic, sauté until fragrant. Chop the tomato, mix it in. Add salt, MSG, soy sauce, sauce, add ½ glass of water, check the taste.
Add the cut omelet, cook until the water reduces.

Prepare the coriander chicken ingredients. I have soaked the chicken in saltwater, washed it clean, and drained it. Make slits in the chicken meat. Wash the coriander clean and dry roast it over low heat.
Roast until the coriander is fragrant and browned, remove. Immediately press the coriander gently with a pestle (the texture should still be coarse).
Add the coriander, chicken bouillon, Himalayan salt, pepper powder, and chicken bouillon into the container with the chicken, stir evenly while gently massaging the spices into the chicken meat, so the spices are absorbed. Add Cap Pak Tani Gunung Tapioca Flour and Rose Brand Cornstarch.
Coat evenly on all parts of the chicken, cover the container, and store in the chiller overnight. The next day, take the marinated chicken out of the chiller, leave it at room temperature for 30 minutes before frying. Heat a lot of oil, fry the chicken until yellowish over medium heat.
After the chicken is cooked yellowish, remove and drain. Continue frying the remaining chicken until finished. Fry the chicken again over high heat just briefly until golden brown, remove and drain.
Making onion chili paste: sauté/fry all chilies, onions, and shrimp paste (terasi) with 1 tbsp of leftover chicken frying oil, until wilted. Transfer all chilies, garlic, and shrimp paste to a mortar, add Himalayan salt, grind. Add tomatoes and coconut sugar, grind again.
Finally, add shallots and calamansi (jeruk limau) juice, gently press the shallots, stir until even.
The cooked fried chicken has a crispy texture on the outside, and is juicy and soft on the inside of the chicken meat.
Coriander fried chicken with onion chili paste is ready to be enjoyed while warm with fresh cucumber and steamed chayote (labu).
strIngredient8: Cap Pak Tani Gunung tapioca flour

strInstructions:
Blend the ground spices with a little water, then pour into the pot containing the chicken.
Add bay leaves, kaffir lime leaves, salt, and water. Boil until the chicken is cooked and tender.
Then let it sit until room temperature (± 30 minutes) so the spices are absorbed into the chicken).
Mix Cap Pak Tani Gunung Tapioca Flour, Rose Brand Rice Flour, and Rose Brand Coconut Milk in a container.
Add the braising broth, then stir until evenly mixed. Add the chicken egg and baking soda, stir again until there are no lumps in the batter.
Strain if necessary, then pour into a bottle with a hole in the cap.
Prepare heated oil, pour enough of the kremesan batter. Once it starts to rise, fold it. Then fry until cooked. Do this until the batter is finished, leave a little to fry the chicken.
Then fry the chicken, when it starts to brown add the kremesan batter. Then fry until cooked.
Grind the bird's eye chilies, garlic, and salt. Then add hot oil, stir evenly.
Serve the fried chicken with kremesan and onion chili paste. The kremesan is crispy and not tough.
strIngredient18: Tepung tapioka cap pak tani gunung

strInstructions:
Prepare the ingredients to make onion chili paste.
Heat Rose Brand cooking oil. Crush the garlic with its skin on then fry until browned. Remove. Drain.
Chop the shallots, bird's eye chilies, and curly chilies. Set aside.
Put the chopped ingredients into the leftover garlic frying oil until submerged. Add sugar, salt, and bouillon powder.
Stir until it releases oil / is fully cooked. Still over low heat. Add Asatu Rose Brand flavor enhancer. Check the taste. Remove and serve a portion. Let the other portion cool, then after it cools it can be put in the refrigerator for stock.

Prepare ingredients.
Coarsely pound bird's eye chilies + salt + sugar + shrimp paste (terasi). Don't make it too fine, so there is texture.
Add the sliced onions. Pound just until wilted, don't crush them completely. The key to the aroma + texture is here.
Pour boiling hot oil directly onto the chili paste. Sssshhh the sound makes you drool.
Check the taste, squeeze lime juice over it. Stir. Done.
strIngredient4: Just a fingernail-sized piece of roasted shrimp paste (terasi)
strIngredient9: Hot oil, leftover from frying fish is even better

strMeal: Nasi Bejek Ayam Suwir Sambal Bawang
strInstructions:
Sauté the chili paste ingredients until fragrant, add shredded chicken, stir evenly.
Add a little water to absorb the spices, add salt, sugar, and bouillon powder, stir evenly, cook until reduced, check the taste.
Fry the vegetables and kaffir lime leaves until crispy, drain. Prepare a container, place the rice, shredded chicken onion chili paste, fried vegetables and kaffir lime leaves, 2 tbsp fried onions.
Stir evenly, place on a plate, sprinkle with remaining fried onions, serve.

Wash the small shrimp clean.
Slice the green chilies and scallions, set aside.
Blend the bird's eye chilies, large chilies, and both onions until smooth.
Prepare a wok, pour in oil, add the sliced green chilies and scallions, sauté until wilted and fragrant.
Add the ground spices, stir until half cooked, then add the small shrimp, add flavor enhancer and salt, cook until done and dry.
Transfer to a container. Happy trying.

Wash the meat clean, add lime juice and salt, set aside.
Heat oil, sauté sliced shallots, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves until fragrant.
Add onion chili paste, stir evenly then sauté again until fragrant.
Add the meat, stir evenly until it changes color, then let sit or cover with a pot lid over medium heat.
Add bouillon powder, salt, and sugar, stir again then let sit until the meat is completely cooked and tender.
Add a little water then cover again with the pot lid, the sautéed onion chili paste meat is ready. Happy trying.

Cut and fry the gembus tempeh.
Add salt and flavor enhancer to the fried chili paste ingredients then grind in a mortar (that's simple).
Place the gembus tempeh and basil in the same mortar.

Cut the tempeh, fry until dry, remove and drain.
Fry shallots, red bird's eye chilies, and curly chilies until wilted.
Grind the fried spices in a mortar, add sugar, salt, MSG (vetsin), and a little leftover oil from frying the onions and chilies earlier.
Put the fried tempeh into the mortar, press (penyet) together with the chili paste.
Add basil leaves, stir evenly.
Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve.

strMeal: Resep Sederhana Sapi Goreng Sambal Bawang
strInstructions:
Thinly slice the beef.
Grind garlic and salt until smooth, set aside.
Prepare a mortar, place the meat then flatten the meat as thin as possible by hitting it with a pestle. While doing this, coat the meat with the previously ground spices.
Prepare oil in a wok, wait until the oil is really hot, then put the meat into it, fry until crispy.
Remove, drain.
Steps to make onion chili paste: grind all ingredients, check the taste, finally pour hot oil left over from frying the meat earlier.
strIngredient10: Hot oil left over from frying beef

strInstructions:
Prepare fresh bird's eye chilies and garlic. Wash clean and drain until there is no water left.
Chop the bird's eye chilies and garlic. Do not make it too fine.
Heat cooking oil. Sauté the previously chopped red chilies and garlic for +/- 15 minutes. Pour in salt, granulated sugar, and flavor enhancer, stir evenly. Check the taste. Turn off the stove. Wait until it cools to room temperature. Then put it in an airtight jar/container.
Sambal Geprek Bawang is ready to be a favorite side dish accompaniment 👍😍❤️😋.

Beat the eggs, fry until cooked, then remove.
Slice the shallots and cut the bird's eye chilies.
Sauté the shallots and chilies until fragrant.
Add the shrimp paste (terasi), stir until evenly mixed.
Add oyster sauce and flavor enhancer, stir evenly.
Add the fried eggs, stir until the spices are even.
Remove and serve with warm rice.

Wash all garlic, shallot, and chili ingredients clean, then drain.
Chop all garlic, shallot, and chili ingredients.
Sauté all chopped ingredients, and add complementary seasonings such as anchovies, salt, oyster sauce, mushroom bouillon, sugar. Wait until wilted (approximately 20 minutes), then taste the chili paste regarding saltiness and deliciousness. The chili paste is ready to be served as an accompaniment for family meals.

strMeal: Sayur Bayam & Dadar Jagung & Sambal Bawang
strInstructions:
First, we will make spinach soup. First, prepare the spinach, corn, and tomatoes.
Boil the corn first until soft. Slice the garlic and shallots and crush the fingerroot (kunci) if available. Then put them into the pot.
Add tomatoes, add sugar and salt, and finally add the spinach.
Spinach soup is ready to be served.
Second, we will make corn fritters (dadar jagung). Prepare garlic, shallots, small chilies, large chilies. Then grind until smooth.
Shave the corn and pound coarsely with the spices.
Add flour, then stir evenly.
Fry until cooked and corn fritters are ready to be served.
Finally, to make onion chili paste, simply prepare the ingredients, fry, and grind with sugar and salt. Done.

strMeal: Tempe Kriuk & Sambal Bawang Merah Daun Jeruk By Chef Ade Koerniawan
strInstructions:
Crispy tempeh: Grind shallots & garlic with seasoning. Crush the tempeh in a mortar, mix with spices. Transfer to a container, mix with flour. For the flour, estimate until it can be shaped. Check the taste; if it's right, heat oil, take 1 handful or 1 tbsp and fry in hot oil until dry and browned.
Chili paste ingredients: chop onions, bird's eye chilies, curly chilies. Place in a container. Add sliced kaffir lime leaves, shrimp paste powder, seasoning. Then pour hot oil over it.
For serving, the chili paste can be poured over the tempeh or stirred in.

Wash all ingredients clean and cut them into pieces.
Heat oil in a wok, add 1 spoon of sesame oil. Crush garlic then chop coarsely. Fry until slightly browned. Do not let it get too brown because it will taste bitter.
After that, add carrots, sauté briefly until mixed. Then pour water. Let sit until it boils. After boiling, pour oyster sauce and pepper. Stir evenly. Check the taste. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute.
After the carrots have been cooked for 1 minute, add the baby corn (putren). Stir evenly, let sit for another 1 minute. After the baby corn is in, it's the wood ear mushrooms' turn. Stir evenly, let sit for another 1 minute. After the mushrooms, then add the cauliflower and mustard greens (sawi) together. Stir evenly. If the water reduces slightly and the vegetables are not submerged, add a little water so all the vegetables cook.
After everything is in, check the taste. If you feel it's not quite right, add oyster sauce, pepper, and sugar. Add a little at a time until the taste suits your preference. Cook and let sit over low heat for 3 minutes. Once cooked, do not remove immediately. After it's somewhat warm, then transfer to a serving bowl.

strMeal: 🍲 Bekal Sekolah 15 Menit. Capcay Kuah Sehat + Telur
strInstructions:
Prepare ingredients.
Heat oil. Sauté shallots + garlic until fragrant (medium heat so it doesn't burn).
Add carrots + green beans. Sauté for 2 minutes (cook hard vegetables first so they aren't raw).
Pour water/broth. Add oyster sauce, salty soy sauce, salt, sugar, pepper. Bring to a boil. Push vegetables aside, crack the eggs. Scramble in the broth so they mix.
Add napa cabbage (sawi putih) + scallions. Cook for 2 minutes only (don't take too long so the color remains bright green and not mushy).
Pour cornstarch solution little by little while stirring. Cook until the broth thickens and is clear. Check the taste. Turn off the heat.

Prepare ingredients as guided above.
Prepare a wok, heat a little oil, add eggs and scramble, once cooked remove and set aside.
Heat a little oil, sauté shallots until somewhat dry, then add garlic and onion, sauté until cooked and fragrant.
Add chicken liver and gizzard, meatballs, and scrambled eggs, stir-fry briefly, then add water until all ingredients are submerged.
Add salt, tomato sauce, pepper powder, beef bouillon, oyster sauce, and sweet soy sauce, stir evenly. Then add carrots and tomatoes, cook until tender. Then add cabbage, broccoli, and celery, stir-fry, check the taste. Separate enough for kids or those who don't like spicy food.
Continue cooking, add bird's eye chilies and chili sauce, stir evenly briefly, check the taste. Serve warm 🤤.
strIngredient1: Pairs of chicken liver and gizzard

strInstructions:
Cut onion, garlic, and chilies.
Boil carrots until tender, remove, also boil broccoli for just 1 minute then remove. Put both into ice water.
Sauté onion, garlic, chilies until fragrant.
Add corn kernels, stir.
Add shrimp, cook until shrimp are done.
Add sugar, salt, oyster sauce, and a little hot water. Cook briefly.
Add broccoli and carrots.
Finally add flavor enhancer. Done.

Boil the noodles until half cooked, then fry in hot oil until dry. Set aside.
Cut all vegetables, set aside.
Heat oil, sauté chicken, shrimp, squid, and fish balls until no longer watery and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
Sauté garlic and onion in the same oil until fragrant. Then add carrots and cook until tender.
Next, add baby corn, cauliflower, bok choy, wood ear mushrooms, water, and seasonings.
Add the previously sautéed protein, adjust the taste, and add the cornstarch solution and water. Cook until thickened.
Prepare a serving plate, arrange the dry noodles, then pour the capcay over them. Ready to serve.

Make the kekian (fish cake roll) first. Beat the eggs, add a little salt, add flour, and mix well. Once evenly mixed, make an omelet in a pan (preferably non-stick) with a little oil over medium heat.
When the omelet looks starting to cook/dry, scramble it until broken apart (large or small pieces according to taste). Then add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add the chicken and meatball pieces. Wait until the chicken is half cooked/turns white. Then add the washed scallions, cabbage, and bok choy. Stir until wilted.
Add a little water. Add all the seasonings. Stir evenly. Then taste test.
If the taste is right, add the tomato pieces. Stir-fry briefly, do not let it get too wilted. Remove and serve.
strIngredient7: Small bunch of bok choy mustard greens

strMeal: Capcay Cumi Ala Ala Bapak Anti Patriarki
strInstructions:
Blend the garlic, shallots, and Ladaku (pepper powder).
Heat oil, sauté the ground spices until fragrant.
Add carrots and broccoli, mix well.
Add water, oyster sauce, and mushroom broth, mix well.
Cook until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the squid, cook until the squid is done.
Add the cucumber when it is almost cooked, stir briefly then remove from heat.

Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken fillet. Stir until it changes color. Add water. Cook until boiling & chicken is cooked.
Add carrots. Cook again. Add salt, oyster sauce, and pepper.
Add the rest of the vegetables. Boil. (Use high heat so vegetables don't wilt). Taste test. Add sesame oil at the end. Turn off heat.
Chicken capcay is ready to be served.

Dissolve cornstarch with a little water, then set aside.
Heat a little oil, then sauté the onion until fragrant and wilted.
Add carrots and meatballs, then sauté briefly.
Add wood ear mushrooms and cabbage, then stir until evenly mixed.
Pour in enough water, then add oyster sauce, ground pepper, salt, and flavor enhancer. Stir until seasonings are evenly distributed.
Add bok choy and scallions, then cook until vegetables are done but still fresh.
Pour the cornstarch solution little by little while stirring constantly until the broth thickens to taste.
Adjust the taste, then remove from heat and serve while warm.

✅Sauté onion and garlic until cooked, add meatballs.
✅Add carrots and baby corn, add water and season with sugar, salt, and broth powder.
✅Cook until half tender, add green beans, wood ear mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and broccoli. Cook just briefly.
✅Finally, add bok choy, stir until wilted. Taste test.
✅Serve.
strIngredient1: Pack of capcay vegetables, cleaned and cut

strInstructions:
Clean the seafood, chicken, beef, clams, squid, and vegetables, then cut them into variations according to taste. Shrimp and eggs do not need to be cut. Next, marinate the beef and chicken so they are not fishy; for the meat, use only salt, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
Then separately boil the cauliflower, button mushrooms, squid, clams, and shrimp, then set aside.
Heat oil then fry the tofu, meatballs, sausage, chicken, and beef until perfectly cooked. After that, continue by briefly frying the shrimp, clams, and squid, but don't let them get too crispy.
Next, finely chop the shallots and garlic, slice the onion and chilies lengthwise. Then sauté everything in oil until fragrant, add hard-textured vegetables like carrots, cabbage, and green beans first in stages; once slightly wilted, add the other vegetables and ingredients, making sure nothing is forgotten.
Stir evenly then add water, wait until it boils slightly, then add soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, salt, flavor enhancer, pepper powder, sugar if it's not sweet enough, and a little cornstarch solution (optional).
Ensure the vegetables are cooked perfectly, adjust the taste, then set aside.
strIngredient26: Ukuran sedang cabai pelangi warna merah dan hijau
strIngredient29: Fish sauce golden boy/ squid /blue elephant/royal gold/food mate

strInstructions:
Cut the cauliflower into pieces. Soak in slightly salted water for 5 minutes. Wash clean. Set aside.
Clean and cut the other ingredients.
Chop/slice shallots, garlic, and bird's eye chilies.
Heat butter. Sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant. (If using,) add sliced bird's eye chilies.
Add meatball pieces (or other protein substitutes). Cook until half done.
Add other ingredients. Carrots go in first, followed by baby corn, cauliflower, and wood ear mushrooms. Every time an ingredient goes in, I pause cooking for 5 minutes. Once everything is in, add water.
Add salt, sugar, and flavor enhancer. Stir well. Taste test. Add wheat flour. Cook briefly until the broth slightly thickens.
Ready to be served.

Peel the shallots & garlic, wash the shallots, garlic & candlenuts clean. Blend: shallots, garlic, candlenuts, coriander with a little water/cooking oil. Set aside.
Peel the corn & carrots, wash the corn, carrots, broccoli & meatballs clean. Cut the corn kernels, cut carrots according to taste, cut broccoli & cut meatballs to taste as well. Soak broccoli in salted water, let sit for 2 minutes, after 2 minutes, wash clean again, remove & drain. Once done, set aside.
Heat cooking oil, sauté the blended spices until fragrant & turns into a paste, once it becomes a paste, add water, add meatballs, sweet corn & carrots. When carrots are tender, add broccoli, add salt, flavor enhancer, oyster sauce, pepper powder & Rose Brand cornstarch solution, stir well, adjust taste, cook until the water thickens to your liking. When the broccoli is tender & the broth has thickened as desired, turn off the stove heat.
And the vegetable capcay is done, pour into a plate/bowl to serve. This vegetable capcay is very delicious, my kid eats this and asks for seconds multiple times. Happy trying.....

Cut and wash vegetables clean, heat oil and fry chicken briefly, remove and drain.
Sauté onion, shallots, garlic, and scallions.
Pour water then add carrots and baby corn, cook until slightly tender, then add cornstarch solution, stir evenly and let the broth thicken.
Add vegetables, add salt, pepper powder, and mushroom broth, stir evenly, then add the chicken and carrots, cook briefly, remove and serve while hot ❤️
strIngredient5: Wood ear mushrooms soaked in hot water
strIngredient10: Cornstarch, dissolved with a little water

strInstructions:
Prepare the necessary ingredients.
Peel the shrimp and cut all vegetables according to taste.
Heat Rose Brand cooking oil and sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp and vegetables one by one.
Add Asatu Rose Brand flavor enhancer, salt, and pour enough water, cook until vegetables are tender.
Prepare cornstarch and dissolve it with a little water, pour into the vegetables, add sesame oil and stir briefly, then turn off the stove.
Chinese-style shrimp capcay is ready to be enjoyed and served.

Cut the onion, vegetables, chicken, and meatballs.
Sauté the onion until fragrant. Add chicken and bird's eye chilies, sauté until chicken is half cooked.
Dissolve salt, granulated sugar, oyster sauce, soy sauce, garlic powder, and water.
Add the solution to the stir-fry. Add carrots, cover briefly until carrots are cooked.
Add mustard greens, bok choy, wood ear mushrooms, and meatballs.
After vegetables are cooked, add cornstarch solution. Taste test.

Sauté white spice paste until fragrant.
Add 150 ml of water and boil until boiling.
Add chikuwa, then carrots and cauliflower.
Add salt, mushroom broth, oyster sauce, and cornstarch solution.
Add bok choy and cook until all vegetables are done.
strIngredient3: Chikuwa, washed and cut into rings

strInstructions:
Mix all the ingredients to make the fuyunghai batter, stir evenly.
Heat the oil, and fry the fuyunghai batter. Fry both sides until cooked. Be careful when flipping it so it doesn't break apart, and pay close attention to the doneness of both sides.
Before making the sauce, mix the sauce ingredients together in one container first to make the cooking process easier. Heat a pan with margarine, then add sliced onion and minced garlic and sauté until wilted. After that, add all the sauce ingredients and lastly add water. Stir evenly until the sauce thickens, don't forget to taste test.
After the sauce is cooked, the sauce can be served separately or poured directly over the fuyunghai. Fuyunghai is ready to be served.

Prepare ingredients. Mix all ingredients and seasonings, stir. Heat oil, pour a little batter.
Baste with hot oil. Pour more batter on top, baste again. Do this until the batter is used up. Then flip the egg. Continue cooking until the outside is dry.
Remove and place on a serving plate. Pour the sauce over it. Serve warm.

Mix and evenly stir the egg batter ingredients. Taste test by cooking a small amount of the batter.
Make omelets until all the batter is used up.
Sauté garlic and onion with margarine until wilted. Add the remaining ingredients, except for the cornstarch solution, stir evenly. Cook until boiling, taste test. Add the cornstarch solution while stirring constantly until it thickens.
Arrange the eggs at the bottom of the container. Arrange cucumber and tomato on top. Pour the sauce over it.

Cut the tempeh into small pieces, thinly slice the scallions and bird's eye chilies, set aside.
Mix tapioca with water, stir well. Beat the eggs lightly, then add the tapioca solution, stir evenly.
Add salt, broth powder, and MSG, beat again until spices are mixed evenly. Add tempeh, stir well.
Add scallions and chilies, stir well.
Prepare a flat pan, add a little oil in each slot, heat over low heat. Pour in the egg batter (adjust thickness to taste), wait until the bottom is dry and brownish, then flip, cook again over low heat so it cooks through inside.
Sauté onion and garlic with a little oil. Pour in the water, add tomato sauce, stir until mixed evenly.
Add fish sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and lemon juice, stir well.
Add granulated sugar, salt, broth powder, and MSG, stir well and cook until sugar dissolves. Mix cornstarch with water until blended. Add into the sauce and stir until the sauce thickens slightly, don't forget to adjust the taste.
Serve the tempeh fuyunghai drizzled with its sauce.

Crack the eggs into a bowl, add seasonings. Prepare the vegetables, slice thinly.
Beat the eggs, add the vegetables and flour, stir evenly.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the batter, spread it to the sides, cook until both sides are done. Drain.
Heat a little oil, sauté garlic until fragrant, add tomato sauce and sugar, stir well.
Add water, vinegar, and finally the cornstarch solution.
Cook until thickened and the sauce bubbles, turn off the heat. Ready to be served with the egg or poured on top.

Beat the eggs together with salt and pepper powder, add flour and cornstarch, beat again with a whisk until flour is evenly mixed.
Add coarsely grated carrots and sliced scallions, and add diced boiled chicken meat, stir well.
Prepare a pan, add oil, and make 2 omelets from the egg batter. After they are cooked, remove and place on a serving plate. You can cut the eggs or leave them whole, according to taste.
Make the sauce: sauté half of the available sliced onion with minced garlic. Add water and add tomato sauce. Add salt and granulated sugar.
Add the remaining half of the onion from earlier. Add the cornstarch solution. Stir evenly and taste test. Remove from heat.
Pour the sauce over the omelets that were fried earlier, serve.

strMeal: Fuyunghai, Minim Minyak Dan Tanpa Tepung 👍
strInstructions:
Making fuyunghai: sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant. Add chicken meat and shrimp, cook until they change color.
Add carrots, scallions, and cabbage. Cook until wilted.
In another container, pour eggs and seasonings, then add the sautéed chicken, shrimp, and vegetables. Stir well.
Because I'm on a diet, I use a little oil. Heat a little oil then pour in the fuyunghai batter. Cook until it turns brownish on one side, then flip the egg. Cook until done.
Making the sauce: sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add carrots, cook until wilted. Pour water, sauce, a little salt and sugar, then cook until thickened.
Finishing: arrange the fuyunghai on a plate then pour the sauce over it. Ready to be served.

Take the chicken breast fillet out of the freezer, then wash it clean under running water, remove & drain, then coat it with squeezed lime juice, let it sit for ± 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, wash clean again, then chop finely. (I chopped it using a knife, it can also be chopped using a Chopper/blender). Once done, set aside.
Peel the carrots, wash the carrots & cabbage, then thinly slice/cut them. Set aside.
Peel the garlic, then mince the garlic. Set aside.
Wash the scallions clean then slice the scallions. Prepare a clean container, then add the carrots, cabbage, scallions, Segitiga Biru wheat flour, Rose Brand cornstarch, add enough salt, flavor enhancer, baking soda, minced garlic, sesame oil, egg, pepper powder, minced chicken breast fillet, then stir well until everything is mixed. Heat enough cooking oil over low heat, once the cooking oil is hot, fry the chicken fuyunghai batter until cooked.
When frying, all the fuyunghai batter can be poured into the pan/it can also be shaped freely/shaped using a mold, all according to individual taste. Once done, remove & drain. Place on a plate, then I cut it into several pieces using a knife. Set aside. (I just shaped it freely when frying, like frying vegetable fritters).
Making the chicken fuyunghai sauce: prepare all ingredients such as: water, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, pepper powder, sliced onion, tomato sauce, margarine/butter, Rose Brand cornstarch, salt, flavor enhancer & granulated sugar. Mix together in a bowl such as: Rose Brand cornstarch, Worcestershire sauce, water, tomato sauce, pepper powder, granulated sugar, flavor enhancer & salt, stir well so there are no lumps. Set aside.
Wash the onion clean, then slice. Set aside. Heat the margarine, once melted, add the sliced onion, sauté until wilted & fragrant. Then add the previously mixed ingredients into it, stir well, add vinegar into it & adjust the taste, if the taste is right, turn off the stove heat.
Prepare a plate containing the cut chicken fuyunghai, then pour the chicken fuyunghai sauce on top of it, then place chopped scallions on top. The chicken fuyunghai is done, happy trying....

Prepare the fuyunghai ingredients, clean, wash, and drain.
Prepare a container. Put all the omelet ingredients into the container. Stir evenly using a fork.
Heat oil in a pan. Pour in the omelet batter, cook until done on both sides of the egg, remove and drain the oil.
Heat oil, add onion and garlic. Sauté until fragrant and wilted.
Add water, oyster sauce, chili sauce, scallions, celery, salt, and chicken broth powder. Cook the sauce until done. Finally, add the cornstarch solution. Stir evenly. Adjust taste. If it's right and cooked, turn off the stove.
Place the omelet on a plate. Pour the sauce over the egg.
Najah's simple fuyunghai is ready to be enjoyed wholeheartedly🌟✨🌞
strIngredient18: Sambal merah (1-2 sdm bumbu sambal. jika mau yang praktis, tambahkan saus cabai instan) bumbu sambal untuk semua jenis sambal merah
strIngredient22: Secukupnya air larutan maizena (1 sdm maizena ditambah dengan kurleb 80 ml air)

strInstructions:
Beat eggs, add salt, mushroom broth (totole), and pepper powder, add sliced scallions, cabbage, and carrots, then add minced chicken meat, shrimp, and stir until even, then add flour, stir evenly so there are no lumps, then fry over medium heat.
Sauce ingredients = sauté onion and garlic until wilted, then add sauce, stir evenly, add sugar and salt, stir, add 1 glass of water, stir until even, then add the cornstarch solution, taste and check the thickness. If it's too thick, you can add water.

Cut cabbage, carrots, scallions, and mince garlic, you can add chicken/shrimp (I made the economical version).
Put into a container, add eggs and other ingredients (flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, baking soda, and sesame oil), beat the eggs lightly.
Fry with plenty of oil, mine was not thick enough because the pan was too big and lacked filling, you can add chicken and shrimp if you like. After cooking until brownish, flip and cook until done (don't forget to poke and baste the egg while frying so it cooks perfectly).
Making the sauce: heat margarine then sauté the onion until fragrant, pour water then add seasoning, if all flavors are right, finally add the tapioca water solution (just a little bit), stir until it thickens. Sauce is ready to use.
Pour the sauce over the fuyunghai and it is ready to be served.
strIngredient21: Sejumput garam dan sejumput gula pasir
strIngredient23: Larutan air tapioka (1 sdm tepuhg tapioka + 3 sdm air)

strInstructions:
Make the fuyunghai by mixing all ingredients, stir evenly, taste test.
Heat oil (quite a lot/deep frying), immediately add all the batter over medium heat.
Don't forget to poke the batter so it cooks evenly inside, don't keep flipping it so it doesn't absorb a lot of oil, just flip it once when the bottom seems cooked, just peek at it. When it is golden brown, remove and drain.
For the sauce, sauté garlic then carrots until cooked, then mix all other ingredients (except cornstarch), stir evenly until boiling, add cornstarch, stir again. Serve.

Prepare ingredients: grate carrots, finely slice cabbage, slice scallions. Cut carrots for the sauce into matchsticks.
Crack eggs into a bowl. Add tapioca flour, carrots, cabbage, and scallions. Stir until mixed evenly, there are no clumps of flour.
Add salt, pepper powder, and mushroom broth. Stir until evenly mixed. Check the taste by frying a little batter. Take 1 ladle, fry the batter in plenty of hot oil. Flip only once so it doesn't absorb a lot of oil. Do this until the batter is used up.
Making the sauce: sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add tomato sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, water, salt, and granulated sugar. Stir until even. Adjust taste.
Add carrots, wait until half cooked. Add cornstarch solution, stir until evenly mixed and it thickens and bubbles. Turn off heat. Serve the omelet with its sauce👍😋

Boil corn vermicelli for 2 minutes, remove, drain and set aside.
Scramble eggs, set aside.
Sauté ground spices until fragrant.
Add sweet soy sauce, chili sauce, tomato sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, salt, mushroom broth, pepper powder and water.
Add meatballs and carrots, stir well, cook briefly until carrots are half cooked.
Add scrambled eggs and vermicelli, stir well.
Add mustard greens, stir well.
Finally, add scallions and celery, stir well. Adjust taste. Remove from heat.
Serve vermicelli with a sprinkle of celery and fried shallots.

Soak rice vermicelli in water, let it sit until the vermicelli is soft. After the vermicelli is soft, remove & drain. Set aside first.
While waiting, we prepare other ingredients.
Heat oil. Add beaten egg, scramble quickly. Set aside on the edge of the pan. Then add the duo onions, sauté until fragrant. After that, mix and stir evenly with the egg from earlier. Next, add minced chicken, cook until the chicken changes color.
Then add vermicelli. Add seasoning mixture. Stir well. Add a little water, then add vegetables. Stir well.
Add vegetables, stir well. Add water (I only need 100ml). After everything is mixed evenly, taste test. Stir briefly and let it settle. Turn off the heat, remove.
Solaria-style fried vermicelli is ready to be served. Sprinkle with scallions. The vermicelli is delicious🤤 the savory saltiness is just right, great👌Enjoy!😍
strIngredient17: Sayuran: saya pakai jamur kuping + kubis

strInstructions:
Prepare the ingredients. Heat oil, scramble the eggs, then push the eggs to the side and add minced garlic, sauté until fragrant.
Add carrots, add a little water, sauté until carrots are tender.
Add corn vermicelli, add sweet soy sauce and broth powder, stir evenly and fry vermicelli until cooked, don't forget to adjust taste.
Fried Vermicelli is ready to be served.
strIngredient1: Pieces of corn vermicelli, soak in hot water, drain

strInstructions:
Soak vermicelli in hot water until soft, drain.
Sauté garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add young jackfruit, stir well.
Add vermicelli, sweet soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, and water. Stir evenly until spices are absorbed.
Serve fried vermicelli with sliced cucumber, fried baby petek, beef floss, and crackers.

strMeal: Bihun Goreng Sayur (Untuk Isian Pastel, Kroket, Dll)
strInstructions:
Prepare ingredients.
Soak vermicelli in boiling water until expanded, remove & drain.
Grind garlic & nutmeg.
Heat pan, add cooking oil. Sauté ground spices until fragrant & cooked.
Add vegetables.
Add granulated sugar, MSG, sugar, salt, broth powder, and pepper.
Stir until evenly mixed & vegetables are slightly wilted.
Add vermicelli, stir well. Adjust taste, turn off the heat.
Serve. Happy trying.

Soak vermicelli in boiling water with the heat turned off until tender. Drain.
Sauté shallots/onion + garlic until fragrant and almost dry. Push to the side of the pan, add eggs, scramble a bit. Add meatballs or other toppings if available. Scramble again.
Add vermicelli, stir until even. Add pepper powder, salt, stir evenly. Add sesame oil, stir evenly. Add sweet soy sauce, stir evenly. Adjust taste. Add vegetables, stir again until vegetables are half cooked. Turn off stove.
Sprinkle scallions and fried shallots.

Soak vermicelli with hot water until expanded, set aside.
Thinly slice shallots and garlic, cut chicken meatballs into 2, chop cabbage and scallions, julienne carrots.
Heat oil, add shallots and garlic, sauté until fragrant.
Add carrots and other vegetables, stir until wilted.
Add vermicelli, season with sugar, salt, and broth powder, stir evenly, finally add pepper powder. Adjust taste, turn off heat immediately, sprinkle fried shallots on top of the vermicelli, ready to be served.

Boil corn vermicelli until cooked.
Sauté spices, grind first. Save one clove of garlic.
Beat three eggs, add a pinch of salt and sliced garlic.
Make an omelet from the beaten egg, once slightly cooked immediately roll it. The sign is the bottom is dry, but the top is still liquid.
Sauté ground spices. Crack one egg over the sautéed spices. Add noodles, salt, soy sauce, stir until evenly mixed.
Fried vermicelli, rolled egg ready to be served.

Peel sweet potatoes, wash clean then cut into small pieces according to taste. Soak in cold water for about 10 minutes.
Beat egg, add sweet potato pieces into the egg. Remove and drain.
Prepare cornstarch, roll the sweet potato pieces coated in egg in the flour until the entire surface is coated.
Heat oil, add fried vermicelli until expanded, remove and drain. Let cool then crush/crumble.
Boil sugar until melted, then add the previously fried sweet potatoes into the sugar solution, stir gently until sugar coats the sweet potato surface. Roll in the crushed fried vermicelli until it sticks.
Serve.

Boil corn vermicelli briefly and drain.
Fry 2 eggs to make scrambled eggs and let cook, remove, set aside.
Grind garlic and other spices, sauté over medium heat.
Add sliced carrots cut like matchsticks, add a little water, leave for a moment.
Add scallions and scrambled eggs, let all spices mix and carrots become slightly tender, then add drained vermicelli.
Stir until all spices are mixed evenly, finally add sliced green chilies.
Check taste... If it's perfect, remove and serve with fried shallots.

Steep vermicelli until soft, drain, cut into small pieces. Cut red chili, scallions, meatballs into small pieces, and grind or grate garlic. Steam potatoes then mash.
Mix all chopped ingredients and spices with potatoes, stir evenly, add flour, stir evenly, finally add vermicelli.
And stir until mixed evenly. Prepare wonton wrappers, slit (like in the picture) but not broken. Add filling.
Then roll and secure by applying water so it sticks and doesn't come loose when fried. Slit, fill, and roll until filling is used up.
Heat oil over medium heat then fry until cooked evenly and brownish. Remove, drain, and serve.
Fry half dry for the rest, remove, drain, let cool then store in a closed container to freeze.

strMeal: Pad Thai (Bihun Goreng Thailand) Versi Lokal
strInstructions:
📌Pad Thai Sauce: Fry shallots until cooked, can be removed and set aside first, but I directly add sugar, cook until caramelizes, then add water.
Also add tamarind water, oyster sauce, and fish sauce.
Also add dried shrimp (ebi), chili sauce, and chili flakes.
Cook until evenly done, turn off heat immediately, once cooled it can be stored in a clean glass container.
Soak glass noodles with warm water, for other noodle ingredients like rice vermicelli / corn vermicelli, see the tips column. Remove, drain.
Heat oil, add chicken, garlic & leek, sauté until fragrant. In the same pan, add 1 egg, scramble it.
Then add hard vegetables first, like carrots, mushrooms, and bok choy stalks. Once half cooked, add seasoning.
Also add Pad Thai sauce, fish sauce & soy sauce, stir until evenly mixed.
Then add noodles, bok choy leaves, and bean sprouts. Bean sprouts can be served raw. But I prefer them slightly cooked like this. Cook, stir quickly until perfectly done. Serve warm with pickles, it's tastier 👍🏼. Let's try it ❤️.
strIngredient9: Dried wood ear mushrooms, soaked, chopped
strIngredient22: Palm sugar / gula aren (sy mix brown sugar + gula putih)

strInstructions:
Soak vermicelli and bean sprouts in hot water in separate containers.
Slice scallions, chilies, and onion, and mince garlic.
Heat vegetable oil, then sauté scallions, chilies, onion, and garlic.
Once fragrant, add drained bean sprouts.
Stir briefly, then add vermicelli.
Add soy sauce, sweet soy sauce, fish sauce, sesame oil, pepper powder, and broth powder.
Check and adjust taste.
Fried vermicelli is ready to be enjoyed.

Boil vermicelli then add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce. Mix evenly.
Sauté ground spices until fragrant then add water, cook until boiling. Add salt, broth, sweet soy sauce, and granulated sugar, then add napa cabbage. Cook until cabbage wilts and add vermicelli.
Stir well and adjust taste. Serve as a family favorite side dish.
strIngredient2: Napa cabbage bunch, sliced thinly and washed

strInstructions:
Strain the vermicelli from the soaking water.
Add flour, egg, broth, salt, flavor enhancer, pepper, garlic powder, stir until evenly mixed.
Heat oil, put one tablespoon of vermicelli batter into the oil and fry until cooked.
Remove, drain and serve.

Cut/slice the sausage, meatballs, cabbage and carrots, set aside.
Cut/slice the green mustard greens, shallots and garlic, set aside.
Boil water until boiling, turn off the heat, add vermicelli, let it soak for about 5 minutes or until soft, drain, discard the water.
Pour cooking oil, a little salt and sweet soy sauce over the vermicelli, stir well.
Heat oil, scramble the eggs, remove, set aside.
Sauté shallots and garlic until fragrant, add carrots, stir and let it wilt slightly, add green mustard greens.
Add cabbage, sausage, meatballs, scrambled eggs, stir well.
Add salt, mushroom broth and pepper powder, stir well, check the taste, remove from heat.
Pour the stir-fry into the vermicelli, stir well, check the taste.
Ready to be served.

Prepare the ground spices. Cut the carrots and scallions into pieces.
Boil water until boiling, add vermicelli, boil for 3 minutes, remove and drain.
Heat vegetable oil, sauté the ground spices until fragrant. Add the egg, scramble until cooked, then add the carrots.
Pour water, salt, sugar, and sweet soy sauce, cook until the carrots are cooked. Add vermicelli, stir until the spices are evenly distributed.
Add flavor enhancer, stir until even.
Serve the fried vermicelli with egg, tomato pieces and red bird's eye chilies.

Grind the ground spices.
Soak the corn vermicelli, scramble the egg, and cut the other ingredients.
Sauté the spices until fragrant. Add carrots and chilies. Sauté until wilted, add other ingredients. Stir well.
Add 100 ml of water, salt, sugar and broth powder. Add vermicelli and celery. Stir until mixed and spices are absorbed. Turn off the heat.
Transfer to a container and sprinkle with fried shallots.

Prepare the ingredients.
Make scrambled eggs.
Add vermicelli.
Add green chili meat and broth powder, cook until spices are absorbed into the vermicelli, adjust taste.
And ready to be served with a sprinkle of fried shallots.
strIngredient3: Bowl of green chili meat, green chili balado beef

strInstructions:
Prepare ingredients. Cut vegetables according to taste.
Boil vermicelli, add a little oil and boil until soft. Set aside. Sauté sausage with a little oil, set aside. Make scrambled eggs, set aside.
Sauté red bird's eye chili and red spices, add carrots and a little water so they soften. Then add cabbage, stir well. Frozen White, Yellow, Red Basic Spices.
Then add vermicelli, stir quickly. Add salt, broth powder. Then add choy sum, and scallions, stir quickly.
Add sausage, scrambled eggs, stir well. Taste test.
Ready to be served.

Boil dried kwetiau until tender, then drain, rinse with cold water, also prepare bok choy and bean sprouts.
Grind the spices, fry the chicken briefly, also prepare scrambled eggs.
Sauté the spices until fragrant, add enough water, add the fried chicken and scrambled eggs.
Add seasoning, all sauces, soy sauce and sesame oil, stir well then add bok choy.
Stir the bok choy evenly with the sautéed chicken and eggs from earlier, then add kwetiau and bean sprouts.
Stir kwetiau while adjusting taste, add whatever is felt lacking.
When the taste is right and kwetiau texture is as desired, remove and serve.

Crush garlic. Heat pan, add a little oil. Stir-fry garlic and scallion stalks until fragrant.
Add water spinach, stir-fry until wilted.
Add egg, fried garlic, scramble, add soy sauce, salt, pepper, flavor enhancer.
Add kwetiau, stir-fry until spices are even and absorbed. Make sure it doesn't stick while stir-frying. If too dry, you can add 3 tablespoons of water.
Simple Easy Fried Kwetiau is ready to be served! Happy trying!

Put wet kwetiau into a basin. Add a little cooking oil, then stir so the kwetiau separates.
Mix the wet seasonings (sauce and soy sauce) in a bowl.
Make scrambled eggs first. Then separate to be mixed back into the kwetiau later.
Sauté finely sliced shallots and garlic. After the onions are fragrant, add minced chicken. Stir until chicken changes color.
Add green mustard greens along with wet seasonings.
Add wet kwetiau. Stir until kwetiau is evenly coated with spices.
Add scrambled eggs, bean sprouts and scallions. Stir again until evenly mixed.
Add salt, pepper powder and mushroom broth. Then adjust taste.
Fried kwetiau is ready to be served. Sprinkle with fried shallots (optional).

Heat cooking oil, scramble the egg until slightly dry then push to the side, add more cooking oil, sauté garlic until fragrant, add sliced mustard greens, sauté again until wilted, add kwetiau, stir well.
Add seasoning, increase stove heat, stir well, turn off the heat.
Serve while warm with sliced bird's eye chili, delicious🤭

strMeal: Char Kway Teow 15 Menit! 🔥 Kwetiau Goreng Malaysia Ala Penang 🇲🇾 Anti Gagal
strInstructions:
Prepare ingredients. Mix all sauce seasonings into 1 in a small bowl.
Heat pan until smoking ⭐ The key to wok hei! Highest heat. Sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add egg, scramble roughly. Set aside on the edge.
Add shrimp + meatballs. Cook half done.
Add kwetiau. Stir quickly. Pour all seasonings: sweet soy sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, pepper powder, mushroom broth.
Finally add bean sprouts + scallions + chilies.
Keep stirring constantly for 2 minutes so it gets a little charred on the edges. That's the "wok hei".
Serve on a plate, sprinkle with fried shallots.

Prepare kwetiau, usually I wash it first and drain. Sauté ground spices until cooked.
Then add chicken fillet pieces and sausage, stir well. Add sugar, salt and mushroom broth then add kwetiau.
Stir well and add sweet soy sauce, cabbage and sliced scallions, stir evenly until everything is cooked and mixed evenly.
Adjust taste, if it's perfect remove and serve.

Boil kwetiau until cooked, add cooking oil, drain.
Grind spices then sauté until cooked. Add egg then scramble.
Add meatballs, leek, seasoning, stir well. Add kwetiau then add sweet soy sauce. Stir evenly once more.
Adjust the taste. Cook until perfectly done. Transfer to a serving plate. Serve.

Boil enough water. Boil dried kwetiau for 2-3 minutes while stirring occasionally. Remove and drain. Marinate with 1 tbsp cooking oil and 2 tbsp sweet soy sauce. Set aside.
Heat cooking oil. Scramble egg and push to the side. Sauté ground spices. Stir evenly and add enough water. Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, pepper powder, broth powder, sesame oil, mustard greens and scallions. Stir well.
Increase heat, add kwetiau. Stir well and check taste. Cook kwetiau until done / water shrinks. Remove and serve.

Grind chili, shallots, garlic, and dried shrimp (rebon).
Sauté ground spices with a little oil until half cooked. Add egg, scramble until cooked.
Add mustard greens, stir well.
Mix sweet soy sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, and Worcestershire sauce into kwetiau in another container.
Add seasoned kwetiau to the pan, stir evenly with spices and vegetables.
Add broth powder and pepper powder, stir briefly, remove and serve.

Untangle clumped kwetiau, prepare thinly sliced meatballs, garlic, spices, bok choy vegetables and bean sprouts.
Heat cooking oil, sauté garlic until fragrant, add shrimp, stir until it changes color, then add beef meatballs, stir. Then push to the side of the pan, add chicken egg, stir until scrambled.
Add bok choy stalks, stir. Add kwetiau and spices, stir until spices evenly coat kwetiau. Taste test.
Add bok choy leaves and bean sprouts, stir briefly so the vegetables still feel crunchy and not too wilted.
Remove, serve warm. Can be enjoyed with white rice.

Prepare ingredients, wash then cut vegetables.
Crush garlic, sauté until fragrant.
Add egg and sausage, scramble until cooked. Add vegetables, cook until half done.
Add water, wait until boiling. Add kwetiau and spices. Stir until mixed and cooked. Adjust taste.

Prepare wet kwetiau, mustard greens, meatballs, and bean sprouts.
Mince garlic.
Heat oil, then scramble egg. After that add garlic, sauté until fragrant. Add dried shrimp (ebi) and meatballs. Then sauté again.
Add kwetiau, add sweet soy sauce, oyster sauce, pepper, salt, and MSG. Stir until all is mixed evenly. Add water, stir until absorbed. Finally add bean sprouts, stir until bean sprouts are cooked.
Pontianak fried kwetiau is ready to be served.
strIngredient4: Bean sprouts / long bean sprouts adjust to taste)

strInstructions:
Wash kwetiau clean under running water. And add sweet soy sauce. Boil egg noodles until al dente. Then set aside.
Blend ground spice ingredients. Then sauté until fragrant. Add salt, pepper powder, and ground chili. Slice scallion to taste. Sprinkle 1/2 for frying. Then mix in bean sprouts. Cook until wilted.
Pour in kwetiau and egg noodles. Stir until even. Sprinkle scallion. Check taste.
Prepare a serving plate. Serve kwetiau and egg noodles with tomato and cucumber slices. Don't forget crackers as a complement, happy trying and enjoy.

strMeal: Soto Betawi Ayam Kampung Kuah Merah
strInstructions:
Peel potatoes, clean, cut into pieces then fry, and also fry emping (melinjo crackers) as a complement.
Boil free-range chicken with 1.5 liters of water until tender. After it is cooked, remove the chicken. Don't discard the broth. The chicken can be fried briefly until the surface is brownish, then cut or shredded slightly large.
Boil large seeded red chilies for 2-3 minutes. Drain. Grind together with tomato, shallots, garlic, candlenut, turmeric, ginger, coriander, pepper, cumin.
Pour in 250 ml of full cream milk. Reduce heat and stir gently. After the milk is added, do not let the broth boil vigorously, so the broth remains smooth and doesn't break. Add salt, sugar, and broth if necessary.
Sauté spices with a little oil until completely cooked, fragrant, and oil begins to separate. Add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, bay leaves, galangal. Sauté again briefly.
Pour the sautéed spices into the chicken broth. Add chicken and cook for about 15 minutes over low heat so the spices are absorbed.
Pour 200 ml of coconut milk while stirring gently. Leave it until hot and almost boiling. Cook for 15-20 minutes, pour in the milk, stir briefly then turn off the heat.
Serve soto with its complements, serve warm.
strIngredient23: Potong dadu 1,5–2 cm lalu goreng kentang

strInstructions:
Bismillahirrahmanirrahim.. Mash shallots, garlic and roasted candlenuts then set aside.
Prepare a pot, sauté ground spices, add lemongrass, galangal, bay leaves & lime leaves, sauté until fragrant.
Add coconut milk + water, then add washed chicken.
After boiling pour UHT milk, cook briefly until spices are absorbed into the chicken.
Prepare briefly boiled vermicelli, tomato pieces and fried potatoes (thinly sliced fried dry).
Assemble the soto, add vermicelli, fried potatoes, tomato pieces and shredded chicken (I fried the boiled chicken earlier) then pour the creamy soto broth, alhamdulillah Betawi soto is ready to be served 🥰

Boil beef & beef offal until tender, cut into pieces, set aside the clean broth.
Heat cooking oil then sauté ground spices until fragrant and cooked.
Boil water, add beef, bay leaves, lime leaves, lemongrass, cardamom, cloves, stir well, then add the sautéed spices, stir well again, cook until done, tender and meat absorbs the spices.
Add coconut milk and milk, stir gently so the coconut milk and milk don't break, add salt, sugar, broth powder, taste test. Cook again until boiling and perfectly absorbed.
Prepare a bowl, pour soto into the bowl, add fried potato pieces, sliced scallions, tomato, fried shallots, emping, sambal, and lemon slices. Serve while hot with warm rice.

Cut meat into small cubes, boil until boiling. Discard the first boiling water. Then boil with aromatic ingredients.
For ground spices, blend candlenut, garlic, shallots, ginger, turmeric, cumin, coriander, white pepper with oil until smooth. Sauté ground spices until oil separates and fragrant, then add lemongrass, galangal, bay leaves, lime leaves, cardamom (crush cardamom by hand, so the fragrance comes out). (approximate)
Sauté spices until fragrant and cooked. In a pot, pour water and the boiled meat. Pour sautéed spices, salt, sugar, broth and scallions. Cook for 30 minutes.
After boiling, pour coconut milk and milk. Cook briefly until boiling.
Fry potatoes. Arrange fried potatoes, tomatoes, scallions in a bowl. Pour with soto broth and meat.

Grind the ground spices, then sauté with lemongrass, galangal, bay leaves, and lime leaves until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and milk. Add salt, granulated sugar, and mushroom broth. Once boiling, adjust the taste.
Add boiled eggs and fried tofu. Cook until spices are absorbed. Add tomatoes. Wait 1 min, turn off heat. Serve with a sprinkle of fried shallots.
strIngredient3: Board of tofu, cut and fried

strInstructions:
Prepare ingredients. The meat has been boiled until almost tender. Cut according to taste.
Sauté ground spices until fragrant, add drop-in spices. Stir briefly. Then add broth water. Transfer spices to the meat pot. Cook until boiling. Add coconut milk, scallions, and milk. Add sugar + salt. Adjust taste.
Arrange in a bowl, fried potatoes, tomatoes, emping, add meat and its broth. Add lime juice. Serve.

✅ Wash ribs/meat quickly then drain. Put in a pot with 1.5 liters of water. Bring to a gentle boil. When it starts to boil, foam and protein impurities will appear on the surface. Discard the foam until the broth is relatively clean. Add 1 bay leaf, 1 stalk of lemongrass and galangal. Cook over low-medium heat, pot partially covered, for about 60–90 minutes, or until ribs are tender. ✅ Grind all ground spices.
✅ Sauté ground spices over medium-low heat for about 6–8 minutes until the water shrinks, the spice color is slightly darker. Add aromatic ingredients, sauté again for about 2–3 minutes until completely fragrant and spices are cooked ✅ Put the spices into the pot containing the meat, bring to a gentle boil then cook for about 10–15 minutes so the spices enter the meat and blend with the broth. After that add seasoning. Stir evenly for 2-3 minutes ✅ Add 100 ml instant coconut milk while stirring constantly.
✅ After the broth starts to blend and is slightly creamy, add 50 ml full cream milk. Stir evenly and cook again for about 3–5 minutes over low heat. ✅ Adjust taste ✅ Serving: Put into a bowl ribs/meat + diced fried potatoes + tomatoes, Pour with hot Soto Tangkar broth. Add: scallions + fried shallots + emping. Serve with bird's eye chili sambal and lime. A little sweet soy sauce can be provided separately.
strIngredient1: Meaty beef ribs / mix of beef ribs and meat
strIngredient10: Curly red chilies, remove some seeds if you want it less spicy
strIngredient27: Tsp garam, mulai dari ±10 g lalu koreksi

strMeal: Soto Betawi Kuah Santan Dan Susu
strInstructions:
Boil meat until cooked, add galangal, cinnamon, cloves, lemongrass and bay leaves. I boiled the head meat and skin separately. Grind the spices.
Sauté ground spices until fragrant and cooked, put into the meat stew.
Add coconut milk, salt, sugar and liquid milk. Check taste. Add boiled head meat and skin. Let it absorb the spices. Remove and drain the meat.
Fry potatoes, slice. Prepare a serving bowl. Cut meat, add tomatoes, sliced potatoes, scallions and celery if you like. Pour hot broth. Add 1 tsp ghee, squeeze lime juice. Serve with sambal and pickles. I add fried shallots and soy sauce to taste.

strMeal: Soto Betawi Versi Ayam Dengan Kuah Susu
strInstructions:
Sauté ground spices until fragrant.
Pour water then add milk, stir evenly and add salt, sugar and broth powder, let it boil then add chicken, boil until chicken is cooked, then remove.
Fry chicken then shred in a bowl, add sliced tomatoes, fried potato pieces and scallions. Pour milk broth then sprinkle with fried shallots and lime juice. Soto is ready to be enjoyed.
strIngredient25: Secukupnya kentang goreng yg dipotong kotak
strIngredient26: Secukupnya sambal ( cabe direbus lalu dihaluskan)

strInstructions: 1. Boil water, boil beef ribs until boiling again for ±5 minutes, change to new water then bring to a boil again, add beef ribs and boil using the 5 30 7 method. 2. Heat oil, sauté ground spices until fragrant, add aromatic spices, sauté spices until cooked. 3. Put the sautéed spices into the rib stew pot, also add salt, broth powder, brown sugar and instant coconut milk, stir well and cook until spices are absorbed and the meat on the ribs is completely tender. 4. Finally add some tomatoes, stir and cook briefly until tomatoes are slightly wilted, ready to be served with available complements.
strIngredient23: Cm kayu manis (aku pake kayu manis bubuk)

strInstructions:
Boil beef until tender, remove and cut into pieces. Grind the ground spices and sauté.
Add drop-in spices and sauté until fragrant. Put the sauté into the meat boiling water,
Add creamer, salt, and granulated sugar. Cook until the broth is mixed evenly and boils.
Serve meat and broth in a bowl, add boiled egg, fried potatoes, emping, celery leaves, fried shallots, and lime.

Sauté ground spices, cloves, cardamom, lemongrass, bay leaves and lime leaves until cooked then add chicken.
Add sugar, salt and broth powder. Add 500 ml of water then cover the pan. Cook until chicken is done.
After the chicken is cooked, take or set aside the chicken. Add coconut milk and water back to the spices in the pan. Cook until boiling then adjust the taste. Give a sprinkle of scallion stalks.
Fry enough duo onions for fried shallots topping, then fry emping and potatoes and the chicken that was braised earlier.
For serving, cut tomatoes into small pieces and add fried potatoes. Add chicken (can be whole or shredded). Pour with broth then sprinkle scallions, celery and fried shallots. Give pieces of lime. Emping and sambal can be served separately according to taste.

Wash beef tendon (kikil) clean, cut and boil with lemongrass, bay leaves, lime leaves and galangal. Cook until tender. Set aside.
Prepare ingredients. Cut tomatoes, scallions and lime. Cut potatoes then fry.
Blend all ground spices then sauté until fragrant. Add drop-in ingredients. Stir evenly. After the aroma comes out, add milk and coconut milk.
Add beef tendon, stir well and cook until spices are absorbed and blend with the tendon, check the taste and adjust to preference. After perfectly cooked, remove.
Prepare all complements. Serving, pour tendon broth into a serving bowl, add tomatoes, fried potatoes, sliced scallions and celery, pickles, bird's eye chili sambal and lime juice. Ready to be enjoyed.

Boil water in a pot, add beef, boil over high heat for about 15 minutes, remove, discard the boiling water, wash meat clean, cut according to taste, set aside || prepare other ingredients too.
Boil water again in a pot, add meat pieces, cook over medium heat || in another pan sauté ground spices, add galangal, bay leaves, lemongrass and cloves, sauté until fragrant and cooked, put into the meat stew, cook until boiling.
Add coconut milk, milk, cook while scooping so the coconut milk doesn't break, season with sugar, salt and broth powder, cook until meat is tender and spices are absorbed, adjust taste, if it's right, remove.
Prepare Complement Condiments || serving suggestion: prepare a bowl, fill with fried potatoes, tomato slices, scallions and celery, add meat and soto broth, sprinkle with fried shallots, serve with other Complement Condiments.
strIngredient25: Daun bawang bagian hijau nya saja ( iris tipis )
strIngredient30: Secukupnya sambal cabe rawit rebus sambal cabe rawit rebus serbaguna
strIngredient31: Secukupnya acar timun wortel (jika suka) acar timun wortel

strInstructions:
Boil meat and brisket using the 5.30.10 method. After finishing, discard the floating impurities.
Add instant Betawi soto seasoning.
Add lime leaves, boil until boiling and cooked.
Add instant coconut milk, stir. Add sugar, salt, taste test.
Serve soto with sambal, pickles and lime juice, don't forget the emping.
strIngredient2: Pack of instant Betawi soto seasoning

strInstructions:
Sauté ground spices with oil until fragrant, until oil separates.
Add aromatic spices, sauté until spices are completely cooked, add water, stir evenly.
Add Chicken, add salt, sugar, pepper, and broth. Cook until chicken is done.
After the chicken is cooked, add milk, stir evenly, cook until the broth boils. Remove the chicken and turn off the stove.
Fry chicken until it has skin. Remove then shred according to taste.
Serve soto in a bowl, add fried potato pieces, give shredded chicken, cut tomatoes, scallions, fried shallots, and emping. Chicken Betawi Soto with Milk Broth is ready to be enjoyed.

Prepare all required ingredients, roast the sauté spices then blend.
